parameters.name: Configuration
parameters.description: The configuration information corresponding to the data destination, passed in as a JSON string. The required content varies depending on the rule action type. For specific requirements and examples, refer to the parameter supplementary description below this table.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the data destination.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data destination.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the data destination action. Valid values:

- **REPUBLISH**: Forwards the topic data processed by the parser script to another communication topic on IoT Platform.
- **AMQP**: Forwards the topic data processed by the parser script to an AMQP consumer group via data forwarding.
- **DATAHUB**: Forwards the topic data processed by the parser script to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for data stream processing.
- **ONS**: Sends the topic data processed by the parser script to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for message distribution.
- **MNS**: Sends the topic data processed by the parser script to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
- **FC**: Sends the topic data processed by the parser script to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event computing.
- **OTS**: Sends the topic data processed by the parser script to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage.
